title: National Institutional Integrity, Public Asset Audit, and Review Commission Democratic Impact Plan
objective: Track, audit, and evaluate public asset recovery, disinvestment reviews, civil service appointment regularity, and constitutional rights compliance.
affected_groups: Former and existing leaseholders and asset purchasers
Civil servants and lateral entry appointees
General public and civic oversight organizations

indicators.name: Public Asset Audit Coverage
indicators.definition: Percentage of major disinvestments and high-value land leases audited against valuation standards.

indicators.name: Judicial Quashing and Recovery Rate
indicators.definition: Number and financial value of petitions decided by High Courts for quashing tainted contracts.

triggers.condition: Failure to complete audit of a high-value transaction within 180 days.

oversight.body: Parliamentary Standing Committee on Law and Public Grievances

complaints.due_process: Strict confidentiality, written reasons, 30-day decision deadline

review.sunset_clause: 5-year statutory expiry unless extended by Parliament
